A photorealistic cinematic vertical close-up selfie portrait of a young adult woman in her early twenties, around 20 years old, seated in a pink gaming chair in a softly illuminated bedroom or streaming setup. Her specific ethnicity or race cannot be reliably determined from visual appearance alone and should not be inferred solely from the photograph. She has smooth fair-to-light skin with a soft neutral-pink undertone, a petite tapered oval face, a narrow delicate jawline, large dark brown almond-shaped eyes, softly defined straight dark eyebrows, a small refined nose, and naturally full rosy-pink lips. Her makeup is polished and feminine, with luminous even skin, subtle peach-pink blush, softly blended warm rose eyeshadow, fine dark eyeliner, long curled lashes, and satin pink lips.

Her expression is warm, relaxed, and subtly playful, with a gentle closed-mouth smile and direct eye contact with the camera. Her head tilts slightly toward one shoulder while her torso angles diagonally toward the lens in an intimate arm’s-length selfie pose. She has long glossy black hair styled in a low ponytail, with wispy straight bangs across her forehead and loose face-framing strands around her temples.

She wears exactly a revealing ivory-white floral lingerie-inspired camisole dress with very thin spaghetti straps, delicate lace edging, a deep plunging neckline, structured bust cups, muted vintage botanical prints in dusty pink, beige, and pale green, and narrow blush-pink ribbon details. Pink crisscross straps span the center of the plunging neckline, with a small decorative bow beneath the bust, while horizontal pink ribbon bands wrap around the fitted waist. A delicate gold necklace with a small circular pendant rests against her upper chest.

Behind her is a large pastel-pink gaming chair with black cutout accents. The room is saturated with warm pink and magenta ambient lighting. A white shelving unit with plush toys sits in the upper-left background, while a small white tabletop fan and miscellaneous objects appear lower in the frame. Use a close smartphone-camera perspective equivalent to roughly a 24–28mm lens, mild wide-angle distortion, shallow-to-moderate depth of field, soft skin detail, realistic fabric texture, gentle highlight bloom, warm pink cinematic color grading, natural shadows, and authentic casual selfie photography. 3:4
